import subprocess, sys
# 1) exact ticket scenario: CreateModel with options + AlterModelOptions(options={}) must unset them
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', '''
from django.db.migrations.operations.models import CreateModel, AlterModelOptions
# ticket scenario
op = CreateModel("TestModel", fields=[], options={"verbose_name": "test model", "ordering": ["id"]})
reduced = op.reduce(AlterModelOptions("TestModel", options={}), "app")
print("ticket scenario ->", reduced[0].options)
assert reduced[0].options == {}, reduced[0].options
# partial: keys set by the Alter survive, others unset
op2 = CreateModel("TestModel", fields=[], options={"ordering": ["id"], "verbose_name": "x"})
r2 = op2.reduce(AlterModelOptions("TestModel", options={"ordering": ["name"]}), "app")
print("partial ->", r2[0].options)
assert r2[0].options == {"ordering": ["name"]}, r2[0].options
# non-alterable options (unique_together) survive
op3 = CreateModel("TestModel", fields=[], options={"unique_together": {("a",)}, "ordering": ["id"]})
r3 = op3.reduce(AlterModelOptions("TestModel", options={}), "app")
print("unique_together kept ->", r3[0].options)
assert r3[0].options == {"unique_together": {("a",)}}, r3[0].options
print("SCENARIOS OK")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(r.stdout, r.stderr, 'exit:', r.returncode)
# 2) project optimizer test suite
r2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/migrations/test_optimizer.py', '-q'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=280)
print(r2.stdout[-1500:], r2.stderr[-500:], 'exit:', r2.returncode)
